stochastic_caveat: mstar_weights, joint_weights are one draw from the unseeded global NumPy RNG in halo_weights.py (SHMR scatter), not a reproducible function of the catalog. compute_weights.py now seeds that RNG (see its module docstring), but a seed cannot recover a draw made before it existed, so rerunning compute_weights.py will not reproduce these bytes. mhalf_weights is deterministic and reproduces bit-exact.
